prompt: Generate the next image. SHEET 4, ANCHORKIN OUTPOST BLOCKHOUSE (small fortified outposts on wild isles). Three variants: A) a single squat square blockhouse with battered walls, chained to the ground on all four corners by giant chains staked into the rock, a teal crystal beacon on the roof; B) a round low drum tower on a rock spur, with a chain running off to a neighbouring isle; C) a blockhouse hanging under a small rock, chained to its underside, with an iron ladder and a hatch. Label it 'Anchorkin - Outpost Blockhouse' with labels A, B, C.
